title: Classic Italian Chickpea Salad
description: A delicious, light Italian-inspired salad made with chickpeas, wholesome ingredients, and a hint of Russian flair.

ingredients.name: Mixed Greens
ingredients.notes: such as arugula, spinach, and lettuce

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chickpeas, mixed greens, and chopped pickle.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the chickpea mixture and toss to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional pickle if desired.
